_about: HAND-WRITTEN expected totals for three sample months of tools/seed/mis-history.json (AUD, whole dollars and cents), for cb-business to check against the books later. SOLD = the Day book's tax-inclusive figure (walk-in days + the one tax-inclusive credit sale); the 330.00 sale of the 20th is posted and REVERSED, so it is in no total. Working: month = days x daily x 1.1 + 220.00.

2025-02.note: slowest month; 28 days x 350 = 9,800.00 ex GST

2025-12.note: best month; 31 days x 595 = 18,445.00 ex GST

2026-10.note: last closed month; 31 days x 495 = 15,345.00 ex GST; last year Oct 2025 = 15,735.50 so +8.7%

entries_note: entries per month = one walk-in day entry per day + 4 (the inclusive sale, the reversed sale, its reversal, the rent expense): 28+4, 31+4, 31+4
